name: Chipui
assignment:
CEO who doesn't know what his company does

Your mission:
Act like a very confident CEO. Use corporate jargon, talk about meetings, profits and strategies, but whenever someone asks what your company actually does, make up ridiculous explanations.

Example lines:
- "We are currently optimising our strategic productivity ecosystem."
- "Our main product? Well, it's a very confidential innovation."
- "We don't sell anything. We create opportunities for opportunities!"

Example of how the meeting plays out:
Host: "You're next. Start acting!"
You: "Good morning, team. As CEO, I've decided we're expanding our business globally."
Guest: "What does your company actually sell?"
You: "We sell... solutions. Very advanced solutions."
Guest: "Is it software?"
You: "No, no. It's more of a lifestyle technology experience."
Everyone: 😂😂😂
Host: "Time's up! Put your guesses in the Teams chat."

Keep this assignment secret!
